title: ID0447749-DC/Si-D/NO-[Multiple] Invalid fw version name in bootnotification is too long
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: Invalid fw version name in bootnotification!
Solution: change FW version to have <=50 characters
yyyy-mm-dd: N/A

additional_info.subject: CRITICAL: SICHARGE D  invalid fw version name in bootnotification!
additional_info.body:
Hi Support,
There is a critical issue found in ocpp communication of SICHARGE D (e.g. ID: GaT5ma).
The recently applied fw update from  v7.0.5-0-gd66ba3a+FileHandlerHF (PRODUCTION)  to v7.0.5-0-gd66ba3a+FileHandlerHF+RC-TR-Supp (PRODUCTION) is crashing ocpp communication during bootnotification.
According to standard the firmware version in bootnotification should be of type
CiString50Type
.
Looks like the firmware was recently changed on these chargers to this new one which is
56 characters long
Depotfinity is rejecting any boot notification from that SICHARGE D!
Please rollback FW immediately!
Thanks
With best regards,
Benjamin Kuppler
